{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[Tomrus]]' '''mother''' lived with her [[Tomrus' father|husband]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. They lived on the floating city for several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], raising their son until the [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] of the city by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the evacuation; Tomrus joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] while her husband retired back to his home colony in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
